Belgium Oil Solutions Manufactures full and comprehensive range of certified modules for the onshore and offshore oilfield market. We provide tailored solutions for all applications and specifications depending upon our clients’ need. We build our modules to the highest specification to meet global standards, particularly for on-road and sea transport which includes DNV 2.7-1 / EN 12079 / DNV2.7-3 & CSC. We aim to provide a complete service from start to finish, working with the client to provide a suitable solution.

The Units that we produce includes:

  • H2S Units
  • Cementis Units Batch Mixer
  • Modular Workshops
  • Tools Baskets
  • Man Lifting Baskets
  • Fuel & Utility Tanks
  • Skid mounted Pump Units
  • Cross Over & Subs
  • Electrical Panel Board
  • Accumulator Units (Koomey)
  • Swivel
  • Hook / Travelling Blocks
  • Control Panels & High pressure Test Pumps
  • Pneumatic & electric Winches
  • Handling Tools
  • Hose Assemblies
  • Wire Rope Slings
  • Engines
